            <div class="postBody">

<p class="rich_media_title ">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3219843/202607/3219843-20260704213504700-1237317841.png" alt="image" width="271" height="99" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p id="activity-name" class="rich_media_title ">Linux内核主要包括三种驱动模型：<strong>字符设备驱动</strong>、<strong>块设备驱动</strong>以及<strong>网络设备驱动</strong>。其中，字符设备驱动是Linux驱动开发中最常见、最基础的驱动模型。</p>
<div id="js_content" class="rich_media_content js_underline_content defaultNoSetting fix_apple_default_style">
<p><span>本文将从内核源码角度出发，拆解字符设备驱动的机制，涵盖：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><strong>字符设备号管理</strong><span>：内核如何分配和追踪设备号</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>字符设备对象（cdev）</strong><span>：内核如何抽象和管理字符设备</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>kobj_map 哈希映射机制</strong><span>：设备号到 cdev 的快速查找</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>mknod 与 open 系统调用全链路</strong><span>：从用户态到内核驱动的完整路径</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>共享内存字符设备驱动案例</strong><span>：简单的字符设备驱动使用方法代码</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>📌 提示：</strong><span>本文基于 Linux 内核 5.x 版本源码进行分析，主要源码文件位于<span>&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><code><span>fs/char_dev.c</span></code></p>
<p><code><span>include/linux/cdev.h</span></code></p>
<p><code><span>drivers/base/map.c</span></code></p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>一、字符设备号管理</strong></h2>
<p>本小节的主线是内核如何管理哪些设备号已经分配，哪些设备号可用</p>
<h3><strong>1.1 dev_t 设备号概述</strong></h3>
<p><span>在Linux内核中，每个字符设备都由一个<span>&nbsp;<strong>32 位的设备号（dev_t）</strong><span>&nbsp;<span>唯一标识。这个 32 位数值被划分为两部分：</span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong>主设备号（Major Number）</strong><span>：占用高 12 位（bit 12-31），用于标识设备驱动类型</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>次设备号（Minor Number）</strong><span>：占用低 20 位（bit 0-19），用于区分同一驱动下的不同设备实例</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>内核提供了三个关键宏来操作设备号：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> MINORBITS 20
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> MINORMASK ((1U &lt;&lt; MINORBITS) - 1)

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> MAJOR(dev) ((unsigned int) ((dev) &gt;&gt; MINORBITS)) /* 提取主设备号 */
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> MINOR(dev) ((unsigned int) ((dev) &amp; MINORMASK))  /* 提取次设备号 */
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> MKDEV(ma,mi) (((ma) &lt;&lt; MINORBITS) | (mi))        /* 组合生成设备号 */</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>💡 设计思想：</strong><span>主设备号相当于"设备类型标识"，例如所有I2C设备共享一个主设备号；次设备号则用于区分具体是哪个I2C设备（如 MPU6050 传感器还是 EEPROM 存储器）。这种分层设计使得内核可以在保持设备号空间紧凑的同时，支持大量设备实例</span></p>
<h3><strong>1.2 char_device_struct 结构体</strong></h3>
<p><span>内核通过<code><span>char_device_struct</span></code><span>结构体来<strong>记录系统中已分配的设备号范围</strong><span>（主设备号 + 次设备号区间），形成一个资源管理表，防止设备号冲突。内核维护了<code><span>chrdevs</span></code><span>哈希表来记录设备号的使用情况：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义在 fs/char_dev.c </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> CHRDEV_MAJOR_HASH_SIZE 255
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> char_device_struct {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> char_device_struct *next;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将相同哈希值的节点链接成链表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> major;        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> baseminor;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 次设备号起始值 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> minorct;               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 次设备号数量 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> name[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64</span>];             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设备名称 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> cdev *cdev;         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 内核字符对象（已废弃） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
} </span>*chrdevs[CHRDEV_MAJOR_HASH_SIZE];</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>🔑 关键设计：内核使用chrdevs维护设备号的分配信息</strong></p>
<p><code><span>chrdevs</span></code><span>数组大小仅为 255，但主设备号范围是 0~511（甚至理论上可以更大）。内核通过取模操作<code><span>major % 255</span></code><span>将主设备号映射到哈希桶。具体来说：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><span>主设备号 0、255、510... 都落在桶 0</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>主设备号 1、256、511... 都落在桶 1</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>桶内链表按主设备号从小到大排序</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>这种设计下：在不增加数组规模的前提下，理论上支持无限的主设备号范围，且查找效率不受影响。</span></p>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3219843/202607/3219843-20260704220245845-83344751.jpg" alt="图片" class="rich_pages wxw-img js_img_placeholder wx_img_placeholder" data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_jpg/S9MJnk0LoFIsCvcl5jickvK90GicNnbickvuZ7sXN1DOLzUb42zqUZPgh1hBPoRSSG9ib26Zoak1ZlV9pY8mfkS7GxibTOONR3ibGklBH8vuGicozs/640?from=appmsg#imgIndex=0" data-ratio="0.38981481481481484" data-w="1080" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="vertical-align:baseline;" data-index="3">
<h3><strong>1.3 __register_chrdev_region 函数</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>__register_chrdev_region</span></code><span>是设备号分配的核心函数，负责在<code><span>chrdevs</span></code><span>哈希表中<strong>查找或插入</strong><span>一个空闲的设备号区间，并返回对应的<code><span>char_device_struct</span></code><span>指针</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义在 fs/char_dev.c </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> char_device_struct *__register_chrdev_region(unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> major, unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> baseminor,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> minorct, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> char_device_struct *cd, **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cp;
    intret</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    inti;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 分配新的 char_device_struct 节点 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
    cd </span>= kzalloc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> char_device_struct), GFP_KERNEL);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cd ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL)  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ERR_PTR(-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENOMEM);  
    mutex_lock(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">chrdevs_lock);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 如果 major == 0，动态分配主设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (major == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) { 
        ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> find_dynamic_major();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                pr_err(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CHRDEV \"%s\" dynamic allocation region is full\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, name);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }  
            major </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret; 
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 主设备号范围校验 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (major &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CHRDEV_MAJOR_MAX) {
        pr_err(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CHRDEV \"%s\" major requested (%u) greater than max (%u)\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  name, major, CHRDEV_MAJOR_MAX - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ret </span>= -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EINVAL;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    cd</span>-&gt;major =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> major;
    cd</span>-&gt;baseminor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> baseminor;
    cd</span>-&gt;minorct =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> minorct;
    strlcpy(cd</span>-&gt;name, name, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(cd-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name));
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 计算哈希桶位置 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    i </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> major_to_index(major);
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 在链表中找到合适的插入位置（按主设备号、次设备号排序） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (cp = &amp;chrdevs[i]; *cp; cp = &amp;(*cp)-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">next) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> ((*cp)-&gt;major &gt; major ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
           ((</span>*cp)-&gt;major == major &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
           ((</span>*cp)-&gt;baseminor &gt;= baseminor ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
           (</span>*cp)-&gt;baseminor + (*cp)-&gt;minorct &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> baseminor))) 
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
        }
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 检查次设备号是否冲突（三种重叠检测） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (*cp &amp;&amp; (*cp)-&gt;major ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> major) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> old_min = (*cp)-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">baseminor;
        intold_max</span>= (*cp)-&gt;baseminor+ (*cp)-&gt;minorct-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        intnew_min</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">baseminor;
        intnew_max</span>=baseminor+minorct-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新范围与已有范围重叠 → 冲突 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (new_max &gt;= old_min &amp;&amp; new_max &lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> old_max) {
            ret </span>= -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EBUSY;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (new_min &lt;= old_max &amp;&amp; new_min &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> old_min) {
            ret </span>= -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EBUSY;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新范围完全覆盖已有范围 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (new_min &lt; old_min &amp;&amp; new_max &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> old_max) {
            ret </span>= -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EBUSY;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 插入链表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    cd</span>-&gt;next = *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cp;
    </span>*cp =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cd;
    mutex_unlock(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">chrdevs_lock);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cd;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:  
    mutex_unlock(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">chrdevs_lock);
    kfree(cd);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ERR_PTR(ret);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>🔑 冲突检测逻辑解析：</strong><span>内核在插入新设备号时，会检查三种可能的冲突场景：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><strong>新范围尾部与已有范围重叠：</strong><code><span>new_max</span></code><span>落在<span>&nbsp;<code><span>[old_min, old_max]</span></code><span>区间内</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>新范围头部与已有范围重叠：</strong><code><span>new_min</span></code><span>落在<span>&nbsp;<code><span>[old_min, old_max]</span></code><span>区间内</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>新范围完全覆盖已有范围：</strong><code><span>new_min &lt; old_min</span></code><span>且<span>&nbsp;<code><span>new_max &gt; old_max</span></code></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span>只有三种情况都不满足时，才认为设备号范围无冲突，可以安全注册。</span></p>
<h3><strong>1.4 find_dynamic_major 函数</strong></h3>
<p><span>当驱动调用<code><span>alloc_chrdev_region</span></code><span>（传入 major=0）请求动态分配设备号时，内核会调用<code><span>find_dynamic_major</span></code><span>从空闲范围中查找可用的主设备号：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> find_dynamic_major(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> char_device_struct *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cd;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 高优先级：在 234~254 范围内查找 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (i = ARRAY_SIZE(chrdevs) - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>; i &gt;= CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_END; i--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (chrdevs[i] ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL)  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 低优先级：在 511~384 范围内查找 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (i = CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_EXT_START;  i &gt;= CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_EXT_END; i--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (cd = chrdevs[major_to_index(i)]; cd; cd = cd-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">next) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cd-&gt;major ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i)  
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cd ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i; 
        }  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EBUSY;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>📌 两级查找策略：</strong></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><strong>优先级</strong></th><th><strong>查找范围</strong></th><th><strong>说明</strong></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>高</span></td>
<td><span>234 ~ 254</span></td>
<td><span>传统动态分配区域，"向后兼容"的保留区间</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>低</span></td>
<td><span>511 ~ 384</span></td>
<td><span>扩展动态分配区域，满足更多设备注册需求</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span>相关宏定义：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><code><span>CHRDEV_MAJOR_MAX 512</span></code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_END 234</span></code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_EXT_START 511</span></code><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>CHRDEV_MAJOR_DYN_EXT_END 384</span></code></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>1.5 设备号分配的两大对外接口</strong></h3>
<p><span>内核提供了两种设备号分配方式，对应不同的使用场景：</span></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><strong>接口</strong></th><th><strong>方式</strong></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code><span>register_chrdev_region()</span></code></td>
<td><strong>静态分配</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>alloc_chrdev_region()</span></code></td>
<td><strong>动态分配</strong></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span>两者最终都调用<code><span>__register_chrdev_region()</span></code><span>完成实际注册操作。在Linux系统中，可以通过<code><span>cat /proc/devices</span></code><span>查看所有已注册的设备号列表。设备号注销时，无论静态还是动态分配，统一调用<code><span>unregister_chrdev_region()</span></code><span>归还资源</span></span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>二、字符设备对象（cdev）</strong></h2>
<p><span>本小节的主线是了解两个结构体的设计，分别是内核字符设备结构体<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>，以及管理字符设备的结构体<span>&nbsp;<code><span>kobj_map</span></code><span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><strong>2.1 cdev 结构体</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>struct cdev</span></code><span>是内核中表示<strong>字符设备</strong><span>的核心数据结构。每个字符设备驱动都需要创建一个<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>实例，并将其注册到内核中：<br></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 摘自 include/linux/cdev.h </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cdev {  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> kobject kobj;     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 内嵌的kobject，用于设备模型管理 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> module *owner;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指向所属模块，通常为THIS_MODULE </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file_operations *ops; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设备操作函数集 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> list_head list;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于将cdev链接到对应设备号的cdev列表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    dev_t dev;               </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录该字符设备关联的起始设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count;      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从dev开始连续占用的次设备号数量 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
} __randomize_layout;</span></pre>
</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-colwidth="146"><strong>成员变量</strong></th><th><strong>作用</strong></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>kobj</span></code></td>
<td><span>嵌入的内核对象，使 cdev 能被 sysfs 设备模型管理</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>owner</span></code></td>
<td><span>指向拥有该设备的模块，用于引用计数管理</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>ops</span></code></td>
<td><span>指向设备操作函数集（open/read/write/ioctl 等）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>list</span></code></td>
<td><span>链表节点，用于将使用该 cdev 的 inode 链接起来</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>dev</span></code></td>
<td><span>起始设备号（主设备号 + 次设备号）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="146"><code><span>count</span></code></td>
<td><span>该 cdev 管理的连续次设备号数量</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3><strong>2.2 kobj_map 结构体（哈希表）</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>struct kobj_map</span></code><span>是一个内核内部结构体，定义在<code><span>drivers/base/map.c</span></code><span>中，用于<strong>建立设备号（dev_t）到 struct cdev 的快速查找映射</strong><span>。</span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><code><span>kobj_map</span></code><span>负责将设备号范围映射到对应的<span>&nbsp;<code><span>struct cdev</span></code><span>结构体。当内核通过设备号访问字符设备时（如打开设备文件时），会根据设备号在<span>&nbsp;<code><span>kobj_map</span></code><span>中查找对应的<span>&nbsp;<code><span>struct cdev</span></code><span>，从而获得其操作函数集</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>void *data</span></code><span>指针中保存了<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>结构体指针</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>probes</span></code><span>数组是一个哈希桶，每个桶是一个链表，链表节点记录了设备号范围及对应的<code><span>data</span></code><span>（通常指向<code><span>struct cdev</span></code><span>）和获取<code><span>kobject</span></code><span>的函数</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>通过<code><span>cdev_add</span></code><span>将一个<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>添加到系统中时，实际上就是在<code><span>kobj_map</span></code><span>中插入一个节点</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 摘自 drivers/base/map.c </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> kobj_map {  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> probe {  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> probe *next;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 链表下一个节点 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        dev_t dev;             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 起始设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> range;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 次设备号范围 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> module *owner;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模块所有者 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        kobj_probe_t </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>;     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取kobject的函数（用于查找） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> (*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span>)(dev_t, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 锁定函数 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *data;            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 私有数据，通常指向cdev </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    } </span>*probes[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span>];            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 255个桶的哈希表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span> 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> mutex *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span>;        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保护映射表的锁 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
};</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>🔑 chrdevs 和 cdev_map —— 两套哈希表的职责分工：</strong></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-colwidth="131"><strong>哈希表</strong></th><th><strong>存储内容</strong></th><th><strong>职责</strong></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="131"><code><span>chrdevs</span></code></td>
<td><span>已分配的设备号范围</span></td>
<td><span>设备号资源管理，防止冲突</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="131"><code><span>cdev_map</span></code></td>
<td><span>设备号到 cdev 映射</span></td>
<td><span>运行时快速查找设备驱动</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2><strong>三、cdev 注册函数</strong></h2>
<p>本小节的主线是内核如何将用户定义的<strong><code><span>cdev</span></code></strong>结构体注册到内核<strong><span>&nbsp;<code><span>cdev_map</span></code></span></strong>中</p>
<h3><strong>3.1 cdev_init 函数</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>cdev_init</span></code><span>用于初始化一个已经分配的<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>结构体，将其与文件操作集关联，并设置内嵌<span>&nbsp;<code><span>kobject</span></code><span>的类型：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> cdev_init(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> cdev *cdev, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file_operations *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fops) {
    memset(cdev, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span> *cdev); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清零结构体 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    INIT_LIST_HEAD(</span>&amp;cdev-&gt;list);   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化链表头 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    kobject_init(</span>&amp;cdev-&gt;kobj, &amp;ktype_cdev_default); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化内嵌kobject </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    cdev</span>-&gt;ops = fops;              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绑定文件操作集 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
EXPORT_SYMBOL(cdev_init);</span></pre>
</div>
<p><code><span>EXPORT_SYMBOL</span></code><span>宏将该函数导出到内核符号表，使内核模块（.ko 文件）可以调用它。</span></p>
<h3><strong>3.2 cdev_add 函数</strong></h3>
<h3><strong><span><span>完成设备号，次设备数量等参数记录，并将字符设备注册到内核</span></span></strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cdev_add(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> cdev *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p, dev_t dev, unsigned count) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error;
    p</span>-&gt;dev = dev; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录起始设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    p</span>-&gt;count = count; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录次设备号数量 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用kobj_map注册，将设备号范围映射到该cdev </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    error </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> kobj_map(cdev_map, dev, count, NULL,  exact_match, exact_lock, p);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 增加模块引用计数，防止模块被卸载 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    kobject_get(p</span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kobj.parent);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

EXPORT_SYMBOL(cdev_add);</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>3.3 kobj_map 函数</strong></h3>
<p><span>这是将 cdev 插入到全局哈希表<code><span>cdev_map</span></code><span>的核心函数，接下来才可以通过设备号查找对应的字符设备，定义在<code><span>drivers/base/map.c</span></code><span>中：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> kobj_map(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> kobj_map *domain, dev_t dev, unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range,  
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> module *module, kobj_probe_t *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">probe,  
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> (*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span>)(dev_t, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">data) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 计算跨越了几个不同的主设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
    unsigned n </span>= MAJOR(dev + range - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) - MAJOR(dev) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    unsigned index </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MAJOR(dev);
    unsigned i;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> probe *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (n &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span>) n = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 安全限制 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 分配 n 个连续的 probe 结构体 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
    p </span>= kmalloc_array(n, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> probe), GFP_KERNEL);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (p == NULL) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENOMEM;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 初始化 n 个 probe（每个的 data 都指向同一个 cdev） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; n; i++, p++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {  
        p</span>-&gt;owner =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> module;  
        p</span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> probe;  
        p</span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;  
        p</span>-&gt;dev =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dev;  
        p</span>-&gt;range =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range;  
        p</span>-&gt;data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data; 
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 将 probe 节点插入哈希表，按 range 排序 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
    mutex_lock(domain</span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, p -= n; i &lt; n; i++, p++, index++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> probe **s = &amp;domain-&gt;probes[index % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按 range 大小排序，range 小的在前 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (*s &amp;&amp; (*s)-&gt;range &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range)      
            s </span>= &amp;(*s)-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">next;  
        p</span>-&gt;next = *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s; 
        </span>*s =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p; 
    }  
    mutex_unlock(domain</span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>💡 为什么按 range 排序？</strong><span>当查找设备号对应的 cdev 时，<code><span>kobj_lookup</span></code><span>函数会遍历链表，选择<code><span>range</span></code><span>最小且包含该设备号的 probe。这种"最佳匹配"策略确保当多个 cdev 的设备号范围有重叠时，能精确匹配到最具体的那一个。</span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>四、字符设备号与字符设备对象的关系</strong></h2>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3219843/202607/3219843-20260704220245845-83344751.jpg" alt="图片" class="rich_pages wxw-img js_img_placeholder wx_img_placeholder" data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_png/S9MJnk0LoFJd0RxV4Zvtp0mLpZPy3jo9nYa6Rj76yOL9LDxCAN3GZVr7SJGAia1cjzJaIsMASibLNWThAgR9gtX285dfIlp1ZMP4ticVGetP4c/640?from=appmsg#imgIndex=1" data-ratio="1.0962962962962963" data-w="1080" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="vertical-align: baseline;" data-index="4">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><strong><code><strong><span>chrdevs</span></strong></code><span>—— 设备号资源管理</span></strong><span><br><span>记录主设备号的使用区间，防止冲突。在驱动加载时调用<code><span>register_chrdev_region</span></code><span>或<code><span>alloc_chrdev_region</span></code><span>分配设备号时，进行冲突检测。</span></span></span></span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code><strong><span>cdev_map</span></strong></code><span>—— 运行时查找设备</span></strong><span><br><span>根据打开设备文件的设备号，快速找到<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>结构体，获得<code><span>file_operations</span></code><span>。在<code><span>cdev_add</span></code><span>函数中调用<code><span>kobj_map</span></code><span>函数构建哈希表。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr>
<h2><strong>五、次设备号的解析与多实例管理</strong></h2>
<p><span>本小节用一个非常简单的例子解析为什么需要区分主次设备号，一个主设备号是如何与多个次设备号关联起来的</span></p>
<p><span>在实际应用中，<strong>多个功能相同的子设备可以共用同一套驱动程序</strong><span>：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><span>不同子设备功能逻辑一样，操作函数集（<code><span>open</span></code><span>、<code><span>read</span></code><span>、<code><span>write</span></code><span>等）完全相同</span></span></span></span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p><span>没必要为每个次设备号都分配一个 cdev，只需要一个cdev就能管理多个实例</span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p><span>用户空间看到三个独立的设备文件（<code><span>/dev/device1</span></code><span>对应次设备号<span>&nbsp;<code><span>0</span></code><span>，<code><span>device2</span></code><span>对应<span>&nbsp;<code><span>1</span></code><span>，<code><span>device3</span></code><span>对应<span>&nbsp;<code><span>2</span></code><span>），但内核中都导向同一个<span>&nbsp;<code><span>file_operations</span></code></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>


</li>


</ul>
<h3><strong>5.1 注册 cdev</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dev_t devno = MKDEV(major, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 起始次设备号 0 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
cdev_init(</span>&amp;my_cdev, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fops);
cdev_add(</span>&amp;my_cdev, devno, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 占用次设备号 0, 1, 2 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>5.2 定义设备私有结构体和数组</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_device {  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> __iomem *regs;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 该设备的寄存器映射地址 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> mutex <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span>;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 互斥锁 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ... 其他私有数据 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> my_device devs[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>];  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 三个实例 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>5.3 在 open 中用次设备号绑定私有数据</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> my_open(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> inode *inode, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">filp) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> minor = iminor(inode);   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取次设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (minor &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> || minor &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENODEV;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> my_device *dev = &amp;devs[minor]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据次设备号选择设备 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
    filp</span>-&gt;private_data = dev;             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存到私有数据中 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>📌 次设备号使用：</strong><span>这种"一个 cdev → 多个次设备号 → 多个设备实例"的模式是 Linux 驱动开发中的标准做法。通过<span>&nbsp;<code><span>iminor(inode)</span></code><span>获取次设备号，再通过<span>&nbsp;<code><span>filp-&gt;private_data</span></code><span>保存设备私有数据，后续的 read/write/ioctl 操作都能通过<span>&nbsp;<code><span>filp-&gt;private_data</span></code><span>获取到正确的设备实例</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>六、mknod与 open系统调用的完整流程</strong></h2>
<p>本小节介绍从用户态打开一个字符设备驱动的完整流程，关注内核如何通过字符设备号找到对应的字符设备结构体，以及用户定义的操作函数如何被替换</p>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3219843/202607/3219843-20260704220245845-83344751.jpg" alt="图片" class="rich_pages wxw-img js_img_placeholder wx_img_placeholder" data-src="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_png/S9MJnk0LoFJiboIicEhkpC2CIB5TKtibSL7hp96ErZkvQwoibvgB754hxlqgabTnBhIkib2lYQY8re7H8MkzyqwggylKZhibdekfWNeic8AjSt0j5I/640?from=appmsg#imgIndex=2" data-ratio="1.1833333333333333" data-w="1080" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="vertical-align: baseline;" data-index="5">
<h3><strong>6.1 系统调用的整体流程</strong></h3>
<p><span>让我们从用户态的一条命令开始</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:cpp;gutter:true;">mknod /dev/mydevice c 250 0</pre>
</div>
<p><span>这个命令触发的过程被拆解为四个关键步骤：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><span>使用<code><span>mknod</span></code><span>创建一个字符设备 inode 节点，该节点中保存了默认 open 函数<code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>。节点定义在<code><span>/dev/mydevice</span></code></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>在用户空间使用<code><span>open</span></code><span>函数，传入<code><span>"/dev/mydevice"</span></code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>通过一系列系统调用，最后到达<span>&nbsp;<code><span>do_dentry_open</span></code><span>函数，该函数会调用<code><span>inode</span></code><span>节点对应的默认 open 函数<code><span>chrdev_open</span></code></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>函数在全局哈希表<code><span>cdev_map</span></code><span>中，根据设备号找到用户定义的<code><span>f_ops</span></code><span>操作函数，并替换<code><span>inode</span></code><span>和<code><span>file</span></code><span>中的操作函数。至此，用户自定义的操作函数正式被调用</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3><strong>6.2 mknod创建 node节点</strong></h3>
<p><span>在控制台调用<span>&nbsp;<code><span>mknod</span></code><span>函数时，经过一系列系统调用，最后会调用<span>&nbsp;<code><span>init_special_inode</span></code><span>函数。该函数是 VFS 层处理特殊文件的基石，根据文件类型为<span>&nbsp;<code><span>inode</span></code><span>挂载合适的操作函数表，并保存必要的设备号信息。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> init_special_inode(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> inode *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">inode, umode_t mode, dev_t rdev) {
    inode</span>-&gt;i_mode = mode;             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存文件类型和权限 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (S_ISCHR(mode)) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 字符设备文件 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
        inode</span>-&gt;i_fop = &amp;def_chr_fops; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认字符设备操作表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        inode</span>-&gt;i_rdev = rdev;         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存设备号 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (S_ISBLK(mode)) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 块设备文件 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
        inode</span>-&gt;i_fop = &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">def_blk_fops;  
        inode</span>-&gt;i_rdev =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rdev; 
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (S_ISFIFO(mode))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 命名管道 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
        inode</span>-&gt;i_fop = &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pipefifo_fops;  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (S_ISSOCK(mode)) ;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 套接字不设置操作表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>  
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        printk(KERN_DEBUG </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bogus i_mode for inode %s:%lu\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  inode-&gt;i_sb-&gt;s_id, inode-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i_ino);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>🔑 理解：</strong><span>此时 inode 中的<span>&nbsp;<code><span>i_fop</span></code><span>指向的是<span>&nbsp;<code><span>def_chr_fops</span></code><span>，一个<strong>仅包含默认 open 方法</strong><span>的操作表。真正的驱动专用操作函数表要等到用户调用<span>&nbsp;<code><span>open()</span></code><span>时，才会通过<span>&nbsp;<code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>函数动态替换。这是一种<strong>"延迟绑定"</strong><span>的设计模式</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><strong>6.3 def_chr_fops —— 字符设备的默认操作函数</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 来源: fs/char_dev.c </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file_operations def_chr_fops =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    .open </span>= chrdev_open, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只定义了一个 open 方法 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    .llseek </span>= noop_llseek, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一个什么都不做的寻址函数 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
};</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>6.4 chrdev_open —— 字符设备 open 默认函数</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>是整个字符设备驱动机制中最关键的桥接函数：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 来源: fs/char_dev.c </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> chrdev_open(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> inode *inode, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">filp) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> cdev *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> cdev *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ret=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一步：获取或查找 cdev </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    p </span>= inode-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i_cdev;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> kobject *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kobj;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> idx;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据设备号在全局哈希表 cdev_map 中查找对应的 cdev </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        kobj </span>= kobj_lookup(cdev_map, inode-&gt;i_rdev, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">idx);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kobj)  
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENXIO;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通过 kobject 反推出包含它的 cdev </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> = container_of(kobj, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cdev, kobj);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 并发安全：再次检查并设置 inode-&gt;i_cdev（缓存优化） </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        p </span>= inode-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i_cdev;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p) {
            inode</span>-&gt;i_cdev = p = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            inode</span>-&gt;i_cindex =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> idx;
            list_add(</span>&amp;inode-&gt;i_devices, &amp;p-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">list);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL; 
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二步 ★核心★ 替换文件操作表 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将 file 的 f_op 从 def_chr_fops 替换为驱动自己的 fops </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    filp</span>-&gt;f_op = fops_get(p-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ops);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!filp-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f_op) 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENXIO;
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第三步：调用驱动自身的 open 函数 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (filp-&gt;f_op-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">open) {
        ret </span>= filp-&gt;f_op-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">open(inode, filp);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>🔑 chrdev_open 三步走核心逻辑：</strong></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><strong>查找 cdev：</strong>通过<code><span>kobj_lookup()</span></code>在全局哈希表中查找，用<code><span>container_of</span></code>反推出 cdev。首次查找后缓存到<code><span>inode-&gt;i_cdev</span></code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>替换 f_op：</strong><code><span>filp-&gt;f_op = fops_get(p-&gt;ops)</span></code><span>——最关键的一步，将 file 的文件操作表从<code><span>def_chr_fops</span></code><span>替换为驱动自己的<code><span>file_operations</span></code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>调用驱动 open：</strong><span>如果驱动实现了自己的 open 方法，则调用它。至此，后续对该文件的 read/write 等操作都会直接调用驱动的对应函数。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3><strong>6.5 open 函数的完整调用链</strong></h3>
<h4><strong>6.5.1 用户态 open() 到系统调用入口</strong></h4>
<p><span>用户态的<code><span>open()</span></code><span>是 glibc 等 C 库提供的封装函数，它最终会触发系统调用<code><span>__NR_open</span></code><span>。在 x86-64 架构上，通过<code><span>syscall</span></code><span>指令陷入内核。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h4><strong>6.5.2 内核通用打开流程：do_sys_open → do_filp_open</strong></h4>
<p><strong>do_sys_open</strong><span>&nbsp;<span>将用户态的文件路径名拷贝到内核空间，构造<code><span>open_how</span></code><span>结构（包含打开标志和模式），然后调用<code><span>do_sys_openat2</span></code><span>：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>SYSCALL_DEFINE3(open, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> __user *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, filename, 
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, flags, umode_t, mode) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> do_sys_open(AT_FDCWD, filename, flags, mode);
}
 

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> do_sys_open(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> dfd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> __user *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">filename, 
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> flags, umode_t mode) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> open_how how =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> build_open_how(flags, mode);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> do_sys_openat2(dfd, filename, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">how);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>do_sys_openat2</strong><span>&nbsp;<span>执行三个关键动作：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> do_sys_openat2(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> dfd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> __user *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">filename, 
                           </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> open_how *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">how) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> filename *tmp = getname(filename);     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拷贝路径到内核空间 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> fd = get_unused_fd_flags(how-&gt;flags);     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 分配空闲fd </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file *f = do_filp_open(dfd, tmp, how); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ★路径查找并打开★ </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    d_install(fd, f);                             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关联 fd 与 file </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fd;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong style="font-size: 1em">6.5.3 路径查找与打开：path_openat → vfs_open</strong></p>
<p><code><span>do_filp_open</span></code><span>最终调<code><span>path_openat</span></code><span>（定义在 fs/namei.c），它完成路径的遍历（逐级查找目录项），<strong>找到 inode 节点</strong><span>，最后调用<code><span>vfs_open</span></code><span>来实际打开文件。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h4><strong>6.5.4 do_dentry_open —— 核心函数</strong></h4>
<p><code><span>do_dentry_open</span></code><span>负责初始化<code><span>struct file</span></code><span>，并根据 inode 类型设置文件操作表，最终调用<code><span>open</span></code><span>方法。对于字符设备文件，<code><span>inode-&gt;i_fop</span></code><span>指向的是<code><span>def_chr_fops</span></code><span>。所以<code><span>f-&gt;f_op-&gt;open</span></code><span>实际上就是<code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> do_dentry_open(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file *f, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> inode *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">inode,  
                          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> (*open)(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> inode *, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
    f</span>-&gt;f_mode = OPEN_FMODE(f-&gt;f_flags) | FMODE_LSEEK |  FMODE_PREAD |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FMODE_PWRITE;
    f</span>-&gt;f_inode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inode;
    f</span>-&gt;f_mapping = inode-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i_mapping;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ★获取文件操作表：优先使用 inode-&gt;i_fop★ </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    f</span>-&gt;f_op = fops_get(inode-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i_fop);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!f-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f_op)  
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENXIO;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (open)  
        error </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> open(inode, f);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 否则调用文件操作表中的 open 方法 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对于字符设备 = chrdev_open！ </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!error &amp;&amp; (f-&gt;f_mode &amp; FMODE_OPENED) &amp;&amp; f-&gt;f_op-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">open)
        error </span>= f-&gt;f_op-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">open(inode, f);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>📌 完整调用链路总结：</strong></p>
<p><code><span>用户态 open()</span></code><span>→<span>&nbsp;<code><span>sys_open()</span></code>→&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><code><span>do_sys_open()</span></code><span>→<code><span>do_sys_openat2()</span></code>→</span></p>
<p><code><span>do_filp_open()</span></code><span>→<span>&nbsp;<code><span>path_openat()</span></code>→&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><code><span>vfs_open()</span></code><span>→<code><span>do_dentry_open()</span></code>→&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><code><span>chrdev_open()</span></code><span>（替换 fops）→<span>&nbsp;<span>驱动的 open()</span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>七、字符设备驱动开发中的函数详解</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>7.1 container_of 宏</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>container_of</span></code><span>是 Linux 内核中常用的宏之一，它通过一个结构体成员的指针，反向获取包含该成员的结构体的起始地址：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* container_of - 通过结构体成员指针获取父结构体指针
* @ptr: 成员变量的指针
* @type: 包含该成员的结构体类型
* @member: 成员变量在结构体中的名称
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> container_of(ptr, type, member) ({ \
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *__mptr = (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)(ptr); \
    BUILD_BUG_ON_MSG(</span>!__same_type(*(ptr), ((type *)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)-&gt;member) &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>!__same_type(*(ptr), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), \
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pointer type mismatch in container_of</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); \
    ((type </span>*)(__mptr -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> offsetof(type, member))); })

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 简化理解版本： </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> container_of(ptr, type, member) \<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ((type </span>*)((<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *)(ptr) - offsetof(type, member)))</pre>
</div>
<p><span>该函数根据结构体成员变量的指针，通过该变量相对于结构体的偏移，得到了该变量对应的结构体的指针。这是一个非常灵活的用法，通过保存某个结构体变量的指针，可以通过该指针反向推出该结构体的指针。</span></p>
<p><strong>💡 container_of 的应用场景：</strong><span>在 Linux 内核中，这个宏无处不在。比如在<code><span>chrdev_open</span></code><span>中，内核通过<code><span>kobj_lookup</span></code><span>拿到了 cdev 内嵌的<code><span>kobject</span></code><span>的指针，然后通过<code><span>container_of(kobj, struct cdev, kobj)</span></code><span>反推出完整的<code><span>cdev</span></code><span>结构体指针。这种"内嵌 + 反推"的设计是内核面向对象编程思想的经典体现</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><strong>7.2 register_chrdev_region</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>register_chrdev_region</span></code><span>是 Linux 内核中用于注册字符设备编号范围的函数。该函数为驱动程序预留一段连续的设备号（主设备号 + 起始次设备号），后续将字符设备（通过<code><span>cdev_add</span></code><span>）绑定到这些设备号上</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* register_chrdev_region - 注册字符设备编号范围
* @first: dev_t 类型，指定要注册的起始设备号（使用 MKDEV(major, minor) 宏生成）
* @count: 需要注册的连续设备号数量（次设备号的范围）
* @name: 设备名称，会出现在 /proc/devices 文件中
* 返回值: 成功返回 0
* 参数无效返回 -EINVAL
* 设备号被占用返回 -EBUSY
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> register_chrdev_region(dev_t first, unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span> *name);</pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>7.3 THIS_MODULE</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>THIS_MODULE</span></code><span>是一个宏，定义在<code><span>&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span></code><span>头文件中。它本质上是一个指向当前模块的<code><span>struct module</span></code><span>结构体的指针：</span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p><span>当代码被编译为可加载内核模块（.ko）时，<code><span>THIS_MODULE</span></code><span>指向该模块的<code><span>struct module</span></code><span>实例</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>当代码被静态编译进内核（built-in）时，<code><span>THIS_MODULE</span></code><span>通常被定义为<code><span>NULL</span></code><span>或一个无实际作用的占位符</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> file_operations my_fops =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    .owner </span>= THIS_MODULE,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 防止模块在使用中被卸载 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    .open </span>= my_open, .read =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_read,
    .write </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_write,
    .release </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_release,
};

 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cdev my_cdev;
cdev_init(</span>&amp;my_cdev, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">my_fops);
my_cdev.owner </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THIS_MODULE;
cdev_add(</span>&amp;my_cdev, devno, count);</pre>
</div>
<p><span>内核通过<code><span>owner</span></code><span>字段知道哪个模块拥有这个字符设备。当用户空间程序通过系统调用（如<span>&nbsp;<code><span>open</span></code><span>）打开设备文件时，内核会自动调用<code><span>try_module_get(THIS_MODULE)</span></code><span>增加模块的引用计数；当设备被关闭时，内核会调用<code><span>module_put(THIS_MODULE)</span></code><span>减少引用计数。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><strong>🔑 这样做的目的是确保模块在设备被打开期间不会被卸载。</strong><span>如果用户正在使用设备，而管理员执行<span>&nbsp;<code><span>rmmod</span></code><span>试图卸载驱动，内核会检查模块的引用计数是否为零。若不为零（表示设备正在被使用），则卸载操作会被拒绝，防止因模块代码突然消失而导致系统崩溃。这是一个经典的"资源使用计数"保护模式。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><strong>7.4 file_operations 结构体</strong></h3>
<p><code><span>file_operations</span></code><span>是把系统调用和驱动程序关联起来的关键数据结构：</span></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><strong>函数指针</strong></th><th><strong>对应系统调用</strong></th><th><strong>说明</strong></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code><span>owner</span></code></td>
<td><span>——</span></td>
<td><span>指向拥有该结构的模块（THIS_MODULE）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>llseek</span></code></td>
<td><span>lseek</span></td>
<td><span>修改文件读写位置</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>read</span></code></td>
<td><span>read</span></td>
<td><span>从设备读取数据</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>write</span></code></td>
<td><span>write</span></td>
<td><span>向设备写入数据</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>open</span></code></td>
<td><span>open</span></td>
<td><span>打开设备文件</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>release</span></code></td>
<td><span>close</span></td>
<td><span>关闭设备文件（引用计数归零时）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>unlocked_ioctl</span></code></td>
<td><span>ioctl</span></td>
<td><span>设备控制操作（无 BKL 版本）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>mmap</span></code></td>
<td><span>mmap</span></td>
<td><span>将设备内存映射到用户空间</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span>poll</span></code></td>
<td><span>poll/select</span></td>
<td><span>询问设备是否可非阻塞读写</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2><strong>🎯 总结</strong></h2>
<p><span>本文从内核源码角度，完整梳理了 Linux 字符设备驱动的核心机制：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong>设备号管理（chrdevs）</strong><span>：通过 255 大小的哈希数组，利用取模操作管理 0~511 乃至更大的主设备号空间，配合链表按顺序组织，提供了高效的设备号冲突检测机制。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>cdev 对象与 kobj_map</strong><span>：cdev 是字符设备的抽象表示，cdev_map 是设备号到 cdev 的映射哈希表。两套哈希表各司其职——chrdevs 管理资源分配，cdev_map 支持运行时查找。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>延迟绑定机制</strong><span>：inode 创建时只挂载默认的<code><span>def_chr_fops</span></code><span>（仅含 chrdev_open），真正驱动专用的 fops 要等到用户 open 时才通过 chrdev_open 动态替换。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>完整调用链路</strong><span>：<code><span>open → sys_open → do_sys_open → do_filp_open → path_openat → do_dentry_open → chrdev_open(替换fops) → 驱动open()</span></code></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>container_of 设计模式</strong><span>：通过内嵌结构体成员指针反推外围结构体，是 Linux 内核"面向对象"编程思想的集中体现。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>引用计数保护</strong><span>：通过<code><span>THIS_MODULE</span></code><span>和<code><span>owner</span></code><span>字段，防止设备在使用中被意外卸载。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol><hr>
<p><span>文章内容为作者过往学习的笔记，接下来会按期更新，预计下一期更新内核结构体kobject解析。如果本文对你有帮助，欢迎<strong>点赞、在看、转发</strong>，让更多 Linux 驱动开发者受益 🚀</span></p>
</div>

</div>
